name: @openpalm/ui-kit
description: OpenPalm shared UI kit — presentational components, icons, and theme tokens consumed as raw Svelte/TS source by the ui app. NOT published; no build step.
//exports: Raw-source package: every export points at .svelte/.ts/.css source under src/lib. The consuming app's Vite/Svelte pipeline compiles it as part of the app build — there is deliberately no build step here.
//check: svelte-check gives the raw-source files their ONLY TS coverage: the consuming apps' vite builds strip types without checking, and packages/ui's check only validates ui-kit's public prop surface at usage sites. Must stay 0 errors / 0 warnings (--fail-on-warnings enforces both).
//devDependencies: svelte/vitest/vitest-browser-svelte back the co-located *.svelte.vitest.ts browser tests, which run through packages/ui's vitest browser project (bun's isolated linker gives each workspace its own node_modules, so the test files' bare imports must resolve from here).
